issue_context.title: SQL: decline empty DB URL on reconfigure
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Per integration information:
" The SQL integration will connect to the default SQLite if “Database URL” has not been specified."

It actually works on adding new integration, that' fine.

But while doing ```Configure``` of existing integration - does not allow to specify empty URL.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/15225823/188264427-37c4698c-bd7e-4901-a7a2-1a9d6a98b2e9.png)

core-2022.8.5
